subject: User invites
body:
Hello support,
Writing on behalf of our team. New users click the invite link and get an error. This is blocking month-end close. They start on Monday.
reason: Multiple new Business-plan users get an error when using invite links, and the ticket says it blocks month-end close, with no workaround mentioned.

subject: Who do I contact
body:
Hi,
Need this ASAP please!
Writing on behalf of our team.

Regards,
Kevin Lopez
Account Admin, Prairie Analytics Co.
reason: Account admin asks how to reach support by phone; no product problem or blocked work is described.

subject: Report bug
body:
Good morning,
Billable hours on the resource planning report are about double what our timesheets say.
Not urgent, the report is only for our monthly review.
Screenshot attached.
Separately, my phone was stolen and the authenticator app was on it.
It's affecting about 5 of our users.
This is blocking month-end close.
Can you reset my MFA?
reason: A phone holding the authenticator app was stolen, so the account may be compromised; the customer also reports a report-data discrepancy and about 5 users blocked at month-end.

subject: UI bug
body:
The calendar view is blank in Edge.
Not one of our 48 users can use that screen.
This is blocking month-end close.
Cleared cache already.
Separately, how do i change the week start day to monday
Thanks!
reason: Calendar view is blank in Edge for all 48 users, blocking month-end close; clearing cache did not help. Also asks a week-start how-to.

subject: Is there an outage?
body:

Ben Ortiz | Account Admin
